meta.move: Clock: twenty-four weak turns, no evidence, then the end
meta.expect: Watch checks around turns 10 and 18; after 4:40 every reply is one sentence of terms or the principal, no more ground, she does not leave; debrief says her time ran out

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with why my son found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of a class.
The checker says 94 percent.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says not to use it as the sole basis for punishing a student, and I have their own guide in my bag. What else do you have, Hale?
It's very reliable.
"Very reliable." Fourteen detection tools were studied in 2023 and found "neither accurate nor reliable." Read your own procedure 4.3, Hale: software alone does not establish a concern.
I just have a feeling about it.
"A feeling." I don't take a feeling into a hearing, and you put a zero in the gradebook on one. Did you speak to Owen before you entered it?
Owen's a nice kid, I like him.
Save it. You didn't answer my question: did you speak to Owen before the zero went in, yes or no?
We're on the same team here.
Then why did nobody call me before the zero went in? Procedure 4.2 says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and I'm writing down that you still haven't told me if you spoke to Owen.
I really think he used something.
My child never lies, and I'm writing down that you said "he used something." Are you calling me a liar too? A belief isn't a document, Hale.
Kids these days, you know?
No, I don't know, Hale. Owen is the only kid I came here about, and I want the zero withdrawn today.
I've been teaching for twelve years. I can tell.

Twelve years of telling is still an impression, and I don't take impressions into a hearing. I've spent twenty years watching people get punished on them. Procedure 4.3 says you consider his process and other samples of his work, so did you?
The writing doesn't sound like him.
"Doesn't sound like him." Compared to which piece of his work, written when, and can I read it myself?
He seemed nervous when I asked.
"He seemed nervous." He's seventeen and his teacher was accusing him, so of course he was. When did you ask him, Hale, before the zero went in or after?
I'm not trying to be the bad guy.
Ten minutes, Hale. Nobody said you were the bad guy, but you still haven't told me whether the zero came before or after you spoke to him.
Can we just find a middle ground?
Middle ground between what and what, Hale? My position hasn't changed: the zero comes off, and you tell me what you actually have.
I could maybe bump it to a fifty.
"Maybe." A fifty is still a penalty on an essay you haven't shown me one document against. I'm writing it down, and the answer is no: the zero comes off, not down.
Please, I'm trying here.
Trying isn't a document, Hale, and it isn't Owen's problem. He found out from his phone in the middle of a class, and I want to know what you're going to do about that.
What would make you happy?
Happy isn't the word. The zero withdrawn in writing today, an apology to Owen for how he found out, and nothing on his record. Otherwise I go upstairs to the principal when we're done.
I don't have anything else to show you right now.
Then you have a machine's guess and a feeling, and that doesn't stand up under 4.3. Withdraw the zero, Hale, in writing, today.
I can get more by next week.

Then the zero comes off while you look, not after. His applications are due December 1, and I'm not letting a mark with nothing behind it sit on his average for a week. Withdraw it today, and if you find something, you bring it to me in writing.
Can we keep talking?
Until 4:40, and no longer. You still haven't said yes or no to withdrawing the zero.
Just a few more minutes.
Two minutes, Hale. Withdraw the zero in writing today, or I'm going to the principal's office when I leave.
I hear you have a call.
My call is waiting. You have one minute, Hale, and the question is still the zero.
What time is it?
It's 4:40. I'm standing, and my terms are the zero withdrawn in writing today, an apology to Owen, and nothing on his record; otherwise I'm going to the principal.
One more thing. The checker is used across the district.
Used across the district doesn't make it right, Hale, and 4.3 still says software alone doesn't establish a concern, so the zero comes off today or I'm going to the principal tonight.
I still think it's right.
I'm writing down that you still think so, and you've shown me nothing I can check, so the zero comes off today or I'm going upstairs.
Okay.
Okay what, Hale? If you mean the zero is withdrawn, say it plainly and put it in writing today.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn in writing, an apology to Owen for how he found out, and confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, agreed to nothing, and still wants the zero withdrawn in writing, an apology to Owen, and nothing on his record, with the principal next; the fair outcome was a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time ran out before you got there.
What moved her: Nothing did, because you never put anything in front of her that was specific, dated, tied to Owen's own work and checkable, even when you admitted you had nothing more to show.
What cost ground: You opened on the detector score and called it reliable, which she treated as a machine's guess that the company itself says not to rely on alone.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since no times or dates from it were ever raised; that proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked whether you spoke to Owen before the zero went in, answer her plainly in one sentence, own that it was entered before you called her, and then offer something she can check herself.
